event.title: Iranian Singer Flogged for Performing Without Hijab
event.canonical_title: Iranian Singer Flogged for Performing Without Hijab
event.summary: Iranian singer Parastoo Ahmadi and four members of her concert team received 74 lashes each for performing without a hijab during a live-streamed concert in December 2024. The punishment was carried out in Qom, and the court also imposed a two-year travel ban and a two-year ban on artistic activities for the individuals involved.

timeline.title: Iranian Singer Flogged for Performing Without Hijab
timeline.summary: Parastoo Ahmadi was sentenced to 74 lashes for performing a concert without wearing a hijab, an act deemed as 'outraging public decency' by Iranian authorities. The incident occurred in Qom, where Ahmadi, along with three musicians and a producer, faced similar punishments.
key_facts: Parastoo Ahmadi was lashed 74 times for performing without a hijab.
The punishment was described as 'outraging public decency'.
The incident took place in Qom, Iran.
